# August 2026

## Automation Cloud Dedicated and Test Cloud Dedicated

### Late August 2026

| Publishing date | Release dates |
| --- | --- |
| August 31, 2026 | August 21, 2026  August 25, 2026  August 26, 2026 |

#### Release highlights

**August 21, 2026**

The following section outlines some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud Dedicated and Test Cloud Dedicated on August 21, 2026. For comprehensive release notes, refer to the individual platform or product release notes.

**Agents**

* New assignment criteria for agent escalations: Workload, All users in group, Round Robin, and LLM inferred routing.

**Orchestrator**

* Triggers can now be created in a disabled state. Serverless machines are now auto-assigned to the default modern folder on provisioning. Webhook secrets are now hidden by default like other sensitive credential fields.

**Solutions**

* The resource explorer now surfaces link, change, and unlink actions directly for a component, with a friendly type label, resource kind icon, and folder location shown per row.

**Studio Web**

* Cloning an empty Git repository now prompts you to add a project instead of leaving Studio Web unable to load.

**Test Manager**

* Autopilot Chat is now generally available, replacing the standalone Autopilot Search entry point (Test Cloud delivery only). A customizable test execution name format is now available at the project level.

**August 25, 2026**

The following section outlines some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud Dedicated and Test Cloud Dedicated on August 25, 2026. For comprehensive release notes, refer to the individual platform or product release notes.

**Test Manager**

* Routine maintenance release; no significant customer-facing changes.

**August 26, 2026**

The following section outlines some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud Dedicated and Test Cloud Dedicated on August 26, 2026. For comprehensive release notes, refer to the individual platform or product release notes.

**Automation Cloud Dedicated Admin / Test Cloud Dedicated Admin**

* The Consumables API key for AI Units and Platform Units is now hidden by default on the **Consumables** tab of the **Licenses** page.

**Orchestrator**

* Job side panel and API updates published on August 21, 2026 continue to apply; see that date's Orchestrator release notes for details.

**Studio Web**

* Local setup for RPA workflow and app project editing is rolling out to Enterprise accounts, with a grace period through February 1, 2027. Maestro Case and Maestro Flow (Preview) project types are now available in Studio Web. Queue support and Base64 file-conversion activities were added for API workflows.

**Test Manager**

* Routine maintenance release; no significant customer-facing changes.
